title: Higher costs disclosure threshold and updated shortform disclosure forms
summary: The Legal Services Council has proposed raising the upper costs disclosure threshold to $10,000 and replacing the shortform disclosure forms under the Uniform General Rules.
what_changes: Upper costs disclosure threshold would rise to $10,000, excluding GST and disbursements.
Trustees in bankruptcy would be added to the clients exempt from Part 4.3 costs disclosure.
Overseas-registered foreign law practices and some government-controlled companies would also be exempt.
Shortform disclosure Forms 1 and 2 would be replaced with redesigned, user-tested versions.
who_it_applies_to: Law practices in NSW, Victoria and WA that are subject to the Uniform Law costs disclosure obligations.

history.event: Consultation opened on the draft Costs Disclosure Amendment Rule, closing 16 July 2026.
